proof_nl: Let t = nr. By the definition of the floor function, m = \lfloor t \rfloor if and only if m is an integer and m \le t < m+1. Since m = \lfloor nr \rfloor = \lfloor t \rfloor, it follows immediately that m \le nr < m+1. This is exactly the desired inequality.
solver_summary: Directly apply the defining property of the floor function to t = nr.
vetter_reason: The proof directly applies the definition of floor to t = nr and the hypothesis m = floor(nr), yielding m <= nr < m + 1. This matches the lemma statement and semantic sketch exactly, with no dependency or scope issues.
